source.paper: Kizilirmak et al. 2023, Small transcriptional differences among cell clones lead to distinct NF-kB dynamics

D.role: prespecified synthesis of A and B only

historical_proxy.historical_filtering: no substantive expression-floor rule documented; apply only mathematically mandatory finite/defined exclusions
source_scale_precedence: If a source-native unlogged normalized abundance is reproducibly available for all five untreated replicates, transform it with log2(x+1) and use that as the closest historical-scale primary.
Otherwise use the source-published transformed abundance matrix as a scale-qualified replication, without guessing an inverse transformation.
Do not use ordered post-stimulus timepoints to construct sigma or mu.

dynamic_endpoints.primary: source-reproducible oscillatory behavior, operationalized from the source's peak-count/oscillation analysis without retuning
dynamic_endpoints.early_activation: descriptive control only unless separately frozen before chi values are opened

carrier_B_rule: Use only genes explicitly represented by the source TNF/NF-kB dynamical model or its source-defined limiting receptor/feedback species, mapped before chi_GRI values are inspected. Do not select genes by observed chi_GRI or clone outcome.

null_and_failure_rules.opposite_direction: preserve as contradiction/scale dependence, not a tuning invitation
null_and_failure_rules.insufficient_source_materialization: refuse analysis rather than substitute a proxy
null_and_failure_rules.chi_equal_1: not used as a target or boundary

promotion_ceiling: At most supports that pre-stimulus historical RNA fluctuation structure contains information about later NF-kB dynamical phenotype in this source. It cannot identify mu with omega, sigma with gamma, or chi_GRI with a physical damping ratio.
